sources.entry: ThreeDee AI 3D Bust Maker - (EU) Generate printable 3D bust models from a single portrait photo in a browser-based workflow.

summary.name: ThreeDee Nova
summary.one_liner: ThreeDee Nova is an AI tool that generates 3D-printable bust models from a single photo or portrait image.
use_cases: Making a personalized 3D-printed bust of yourself or someone else
Creating custom gifts or keepsakes from a photo
Generating a print-ready 3D file without modeling skills
Prototyping a figure or avatar from a portrait
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a browser-based workflow where you upload a single photo and receive a 3D bust model, which you can preview in 3D before downloading for printing. The bust is described as a model with 3D geometry that is intended to be printable directly, though the page notes minor adjustments may sometimes be needed depending on the printer. The site also says ThreeDee Nova can generate 3D models from text prompts, with community examples shown. Pricing is per credit, where one credit equals one generated 3D model.
notable: Single photo input, no scanning or manual modeling needed
caveats: Paid plans required: Hobby $3 for 3 credits, Enthusiast $9 for 10 credits, Pro $15 (listed as $20 struck through) for 20 credits
Minor adjustments may be needed for some prints depending on printer or project
Testimonials on the page are promotional and were not used as facts
